entries.subject: Galileo SSI frame C0368591600 in the Monochrome lens
entries.finding: Thebe is a 77-pixel lit crescent, and no level reconciles it with the other frames: without it their fitted levels span 1 to 0.59 instead of 1 to 0.20.
entries.revisitWhen: An overlapping frame can set its level, or a closer view of the same longitudes is released.

entries.subject: Selected Galileo SSI clear frames
entries.finding: C0401759200, C0401787200, C0420691700 and C0532888400 supply the retained coarse Monochrome lens. Repeated exposures/cutouts and lower-resolution duplicates add no useful coverage. The selection does not qualify independent surface-feature registration.

entries.subject: Juno SRU PIA26751 image
entries.finding: The README records a useful approximately 3 km per pixel candidate but no precise camera geometry, calibration or registered science release.
entries.revisitWhen: A source release supplies camera geometry, calibration and a registered product for this observation.

entries.subject: Photojournal composites and Voyager observations
entries.finding: The README records press composites as enlarged or rotated displays and Voyager observations as unresolved or coarser than the selected Galileo coverage.
entries.revisitWhen: A native product provides registered coverage that improves the selected Galileo observations.

entries.subject: Stooke j14thebe.tab radius grid
entries.finding: The released 5-degree radius grid supplies geometry and explicitly model-derived Elevation, not a separately measured altimetric surface.

entries.subject: Galileo SSI C0420644201
entries.finding: The survey retained this frame as an unused candidate because useful registration remained unresolved.
entries.revisitWhen: A controlled camera solution demonstrates useful independently registered coverage for C0420644201.

entries.subject: Denk et al. (2026), Figure 10
entries.finding: The review cross-checks Galileo image identifiers, resolution and native north-down orientation. Its artwork is not a texture; no separate mapped composition or geology product was identified.
